No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave and no teaching relief for new parents in any saved document. Not components: sabbatical leave (study, research, renewal; 75% pay; not usable for a birth); faculty leave between terms; civil, military and bereavement leave; Emergency Administrative Leave with pay (placed by the President in the University's interest, not requested by the employee); compensatory leave (12-month staff only, earned for overtime); the sick-leave class-staffing policy (colleagues cover two weeks of classes; not a benefit of the employee); Board rule that leaves approved by the Board may be included in probationary service (counts leave toward the clock, the reverse of an extension).
The tenure-clock policy adds that if family care requires further delay 'it is expected that the faculty member would request an unpaid leave of absence' (c4).

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks from the birth (c3, unpaid, job-protected), with her own sick leave for the postnatal condition (c2, up to 6 weeks, own balance) within it; long-term disability (c8, employee-paid) only after a 3-month qualifying disability; tenure clock 1 year on request (c6).

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks (c3, unpaid; sick leave may not be used for care of a family member); tenure clock 1 year on request (c6). Both parents employed by the University: combined 12 weeks of FMLA.

Cross-references not saved: Louisiana Civil Service General Circular No. 1126 (PPM Appendix 14); UL System PPM on Shared Sick Leave and the campus Shared Sick Leave policy; UL System PPM on sabbatical leave; ULS Policies and Procedures on Emergency Administrative Leave; Board of Regents Statement on Academic Freedom, Tenure and Responsibility (Appendix A, Document II); Request for Family or Medical Leave form; U.S. Department of Labor FMLA designation and certification forms; Civil Service rules; ULS outside employment PPM; other Faculty Handbook Appendix A documents (X, XII, XVI, XVII, XVIII, XXVI, XXXV, XXXIX); Staff Handbook.
